description: Form-associated comment form composing <markdown-editor> + Submit / Cancel buttons. Used standalone or as the reply-form template inside <comment-thread>. Presentational with respect to persistence.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name (submitted with parent form). Stays on the host; the inner textarea is not named, so the value submits once.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Pre-filled markdown content (e.g. for edit mode)

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Editor placeholder text (forwarded to the inner <markdown-editor>)

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name for the editor textarea. Falls back to an associated <label>'s text, then "Comment".

attributes.name: data-max-length
attributes.description: Maximum character length for validation; also shows a counter that announces only near or over the limit

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Requires a non-empty value; a blocked submit reports the validation message

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the editor and buttons (a disabled ancestor <fieldset> does the same)

attributes.name: aria-busy
attributes.description: "true" while a comment-box:submit waitUntil() promise is pending

events.name: comment-box:submit
events.description: Bubbles, cancelable, dispatched synchronously. Do nothing: the value clears. waitUntil(promise): the box is busy until it settles; resolve clears, reject keeps the value. preventDefault() (during the handler, not after an await): the value is kept and nothing else happens. An invalid value does not fire this; it reports the validation message instead.

events.name: comment-box:input
events.description: Fires on every keystroke and after clear()

properties.name: busy
properties.description: Read-only. True while a submit waitUntil() promise is pending

methods.name: clear()
methods.description: Clear the value and emit comment-box:input

methods.name: reportValidity()
methods.description: Check validity and show the message

childAttributes.name: slot
childAttributes.description: slot="toolbar" children move into the tool group left of the buttons (kept across reconnects)
